### It Rarely “Is What It Is”
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-february-19-2021.html
Passage: John 5:17
Points:
- People often surrender to resignation by assuming difficult circumstances will never change.
- Human perspective is limited, and situations are rarely what they appear to be on the surface.
- Just as in the story of Naomi and Ruth, God moves behind the scenes to arrange redemption and provision.
- Jesus revealed that the Father never stops working, meaning God is active even during silent seasons.
- Believers can trust that God is constantly orchestrating events for their growth and His glory.

### The Son of God
Author: One Year Devotions for Men
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-son-of-god-one-year-devotions-for-men-december-16.html
Passage: John 5:17
Points:
- The validity of Christianity rests solely on the identity and claims of Jesus Christ.
- When challenged for healing on the Sabbath, Jesus defended Himself by equating His work with His Father's work.
- The Jewish authorities recognized His defense as an undeniable claim to deity.
- Jesus further affirmed His divine authority to grant eternal life, raise the dead, and execute judgment.
- Because Jesus is God incarnate, responding to Him in faith is of ultimate importance.

### Life from Father and Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/life-father-and-son
Passage: John 5:26
Points:
- Only God is inherently self-existent and the ultimate author of life.
- Jesus’ claim to have life in Himself demonstrates His true deity and eternal sonship.
- Because the Son shares this divine life with the Father, He possesses the authority to impart life to whom He wills.
- Eternal life is received immediately through faith in Christ and will culminate in physical resurrection.
- While salvation rests solely on God's mercy through faith, genuine trust in Christ is shown through righteous living.
